summary: Practise CTD dossier mapping, regulatory intelligence triage and lifecycle reviews. Explore the course outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: Regulatory affairs connects pharmaceutical product evidence with dossier requirements for registering and maintaining medicines. For regulatory affairs specialists, submission coordinators and quality professionals, this course develops practical skills in mapping evidence to CTD structure, identifying dossier gaps, sequencing submission tasks, triaging regulatory intelligence and assessing post-approval change impacts. Exercises include building checklists, traceability maps and status reports; eCTD workflows and ICH Q12 lifecycle concepts are introduced at an operational level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate pharmaceutical product dossiers, submission evidence and post-approval regulatory work.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with pharmaceutical products, product development or regulated documentation is recommended. No coding or eCTD publishing software is required for the course exercises.
